findings: 2026-11-05: drafted for Mathematics 11 Unit 6 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.

Book correction: In the backward sum the book prints the third term as (\ell + 2d). Going backwards every term is d less than the previous one, so after \ell and \ell - d comes (\ell - 2d). The correct line is S_n = \ell + (\ell - d) + (\ell - 2d) + \cdots Only with \ell - 2d does it pair with a_1 + 2d to give a_1 + \ell, as the next step needs.
